column3: At the inn
We're finally here. So this is the inn we're lodging at?
With that, the first day of the school trip comes to an end.
We finally reached the hotel on 3rd Street.
Ah... I'm exhausted. My waist hurts after walking so much.
Are you all right, Grandpa? This is just the first day～
You're noisy.
Ah, both of you are finally back.
Akagi, you...
Oh, you don't have to thank me.
This guy is Akagi Kouhei. He is my classmate and he has a younger sister in the first year in our school.
So he's also an "elder brother".
Our members have all gathered now, so let's enter the inn.
I brought the luggage into the room and went to the lobby to take a break.
Phew... I'm much more relaxed without my sister...
Hey, Kousaka. There's still some time before dinner is ready, want to take a look around the inn?
Let me take a break first!
Hey hey, youth is gone before you can say it!
Furthermore, there are souvenirs my sister asked me to get.
Ah, me too!
You too, huh.
It's rare that we come here, so let's go to the shops together?
No problem.
...I recall Kirino wanted some raw yatsuhashi... and...
All right, let's go.
